items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: we were asked to do a tribute to Mingus when Mingus passed away... I'd written this tune called 'You Never Said You Had Go.' And he presented it in that context, as to why I'd written this music, just for Mingus.

ctx.x: You can hear an orchestra doing this. Carter brought this tune in called “Rise from Atlantis.” It had the same effect on me. I could hear the horns. I could hear the strings. I could hear the percussion. I mean it was an awesome tune. So Carter, I says, this was well worth the wait, you know, for your not contributing any music in this band. And we had a couple of anecdotes with Woody that were priceless. Because we were asked to do a tribute to Mingus when Mingus passed away. At Carnegie Hall. And of course the…
Tell me what a typical week is like for a musician like yourself in New York.
